coverage_check: League-wide screen of every tackle in the PFF 2025/2026 top-50 tackle grades and every team's depth-chart LT starter (nflverse depth_charts 2025/2026), including reserve/IR and free agents (no free-agent LT met the screen). Side resolved from nflverse depth charts (LT vs RT starter snapshots), not Madden. Every 2026 LT starter with PFF 74+ is in the contention set or listed in excluded. PAYWALLED GAPS: PFF pass-block/run-block sub-grades, pressures and sacks allowed, and true-pass-set data are PFF+ only (blank on public pages); substitutes: ESPN pass-block and run-block win rate (public top-20 OT lists only, through Week 7), PFF overall grade with PFF pass-block/run-block snap counts, nflverse play-by-play penalties by player (holding, false start), nflverse snap counts and injury reports. Unmatched join: Paris Johnson Jr. snap counts (nflverse name) - PFF snaps used.
contention_basis: Candidate audit only per commissioner t45s395: 10 proposed top-10 LTs plus 3 first-outs (Tunsil, Paris Johnson Jr., Campbell). Judgment, not formula. LT evidence: PFF overall grade (2025 full season + 2026 through Week 8), PFF pass/run-block snaps, ESPN PBWR/RBWR where published, penalties, snaps at LT, availability.
